feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Virgin Media O2 to cut thousands of jobs in bid to reduce costs
articles.summary: Virgin Media ‌O2 (VMO2) is set to cut thousands of jobs, as it looks to save around £300m through "a reduction in the size of the workforce".

articles.title: Under-fire Poundland owner Gordon Brothers defends stewardship
articles.summary: Poundland's controlling shareholder has told the government it stands by its stewardship record even as it faces mounting pressure over the crisis which has left the discount retailer on the brink of administration.

articles.title: Plans revealed for AI data centre at former power station in North Yorkshire
articles.summary: Energy giant Drax has announced plans to build an AI data centre on 4.5 hectares of land at its North Yorkshire site.

articles.title: Job satisfaction hits record low as men drive drop in people wanting full-time work
articles.summary: Men are driving a fall in appetite for full-time work, while job satisfaction has dropped to an all-time low, new research shows.

articles.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
articles.summary: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

articles.title: Prepare for cyber attacks or face empty shelves, businesses told
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is "helping to industrialise cyber attacks" and is "highly likely" to be used in attacks on Britain's critical national infrastructure by 2028, the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has warned.

articles.title: Burnham will 'reshape Commonwealth' as he joins King in Caribbean
articles.summary: The prime minister has said the UK will play a leading role reshaping the Commonwealth, including pursuing a debt "reset" to help nations struggling with higher borrowing costs.

articles.title: Two teens arrested after five boys stabbed at Halloween party
articles.summary: Two boys have been arrested after five teenagers were seriously injured when they were allegedly stabbed at a party on Halloween.

articles.title: Trans row nurse Sandie Peggie loses discrimination case against union
articles.summary: The Royal College of Nursing (RCN) did not discriminate against one of its members because of her gender beliefs, a tribunal has ruled.

articles.title: Major business group calls for fundamental change in UK-EU relationship
articles.summary: A major UK business group has called on the government to "fundamentally reassess" the country's relationship with the EU, as it said the current system is still "failing to deliver".
